items.lede: In YouTube’s latest update, viewers can tweak what the algorithm shows on their front page and curate it to a specific vibe.
items.title: YouTube’s Custom Feeds Give You More Control Over the Algorithm

items.lede: ouTube’s new custom feeds let users describe the videos they want to see in their own words, then use Gemini to build a personalized feed around the request.
items.title: YouTube will let you build your own algorithm with AI

items.lede: Microdrama fans might find it easier to follow their favorite shows too.
items.title: YouTube will soon let you generate custom feeds and use GIFs in comments

items.lede: YouTube is rolling out GIF replies, voice-powered TV comments, personalized moderation, paid members-only communities, and new ways for fans to support their favorite creators.
items.title: YouTube is making comments more fun — and fandom more lucrative for creators

items.lede: YouTube's next year could change the content you see with a big focus on AI and livestreams.
items.title: YouTube promises custom feeds and a lot more AI later this year
